Subject: Renewal coming up — request to add isolated analytics cluster and extend term

Hi Rishi,

Our renewal for Private (contract RW-7221) is up June 30. We want to consolidate the renewal conversation early: Novamed is planning to spin up an isolated analytics environment for PHI-adjacent processing. High level asks:
- Add a new VPC-isolated analytics cluster (2x A100 equivalent) dedicated to Novamed-analytics
- Maintain existing runtime for production traffic; request a 12-month term extension from July 1
- Provide SOC2 evidence and a network diagram for our security review

Can you confirm feasibility and an initial cost delta? Also copying Procurement (Liam) to keep PO timeline transparent.

Thanks,
Emma

Emma —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: we can provision an isolated analytics cluster and extend the term; estimate attached for a 12-month extension plus cluster add. High-level notes:
- Technical: isolation via dedicated VPC + strict routing; Soojin (cc'd) will confirm lead times for cluster pinning and network handoff
- Commercial: we can offer a volume-backed discount if you commit to the 12-month extension and include a monthly minimum for the analytics cluster

I've attached a preliminary SOW and included an estimated delta. Marissa will follow up on pricing and options for a committed-burst vs. reserved pool.

Next steps:
1) Soojin to confirm technical feasibility & ETA
2) Marissa to send two pricing options (reserved vs burst) by Friday 5/8
3) Emma/Liam to confirm whether Novamed needs air-gapped or just VPC-isolated topology

Rishi

Subject: Pricing options for Novamed cluster add — reserved vs burst

Hi Emma / Liam —

Attached is a short pricing memo and two options:
- Option A (Reserved): 12-month reserved capacity for the analytics cluster (2x A100-eq) — predictable monthly charge, 15% discount on token pricing, 3% platform fee waived for first quarter.
- Option B (Burst): Pay-as-you-go burst pool with committed baseline (lower upfront commitment) — higher per-token cost, but no long-term commit for burst windows.

Estimate (monthly delta):
- Reserved: $62,000 / month (incl. reserved compute, network egress estimate)
- Burst: $38,000 baseline + variable usage

We can also do a blended approach (reserve 1 node, burst 1 node) to reduce risk. If you confirm reserved, we will add a 10% contract-level renewal credit for multi-year consideration.

Open questions:
- Does Novamed require an air-gapped site certificate or is VPC isolation sufficient?
- Desired SLA for the analytics environment? Standard dedicated SLA applies unless you request an elevated SLA.

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through numbers.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 14:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing options for Novamed cluster add — reserved vs burst

Liam / Emma —

Technical confirmation: we support VPC-isolated dedicated clusters with customer-managed KMS. Key details:
- Lead time: 4–6 weeks to provision & validate (network handoff + compliance checks). If SOW signed by June 1 we can target cutover week of July 13.
- Network: we will provide a network diagram (attached) showing the dedicated VPC, transit gateway routing, and egress control points. Traffic to production runtime is via private peering only; no public egress is required unless you opt in.
- Audit artifacts: SOC2 report (2025) attached; we have a package for security questionnaires (we can push an NDA-safe folder).

Two technical caveats:
1) If Novamed requires strict air-gap (no peering at all) lead time increases to ~10–12 weeks and requires on-prem appliance work.
2) Disk encryption with your KMS will add a short integration window (1–2 days) during validation.

I can schedule an ops call next week with our infra team to review the diagram and cutoff steps.

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
